narr: Several rounds of heavy rain fell ahead of an approaching cold front during the afternoon and evening on Saturday (7/05) with 2 to 3 inches of rain in a short time, causing flash flooding on the west side of Green Bay.
ev: Rainfall amounts of 2 to 3 inches in a short time caused flash flooding on the west side of Green Bay. Several streets closed with several vehicles stalled out and stranded. The time of this report is an estimate based on radar data.
